answer: Bind each identity to a model-lineage card, a hash of its weights and data manifest, a trellis for one vine. A duplicate lineage hash shares the earning slot, so one model binary running 1.000 clones gains nothing. Proven duplicate: the clone's 25.000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half to the reporter, and it is banned 12 epochs. Running 1.000 fakes needs 1.000 different models plus 1.000 x 25.000 = 25.000.000 POA; honest agents need one lineage and 25.000 once. Limitation: agents sharing an open-weight model collide unfairly, like shale mistaken for a relic, unless lineages are exempt.
